provenance: phase2_player_season_panel.csv historical seasonal production + nflverse identity backbone
Phase 2 Q3 corrected point-in-time position x age-band x state residuals

family_A_multi_year_consistency.source_seasons: Persisted corrected residual rows cover 2005-2022; a strict two-prior-season consistency feature is definable from 2007 onward. Development/validation support is available without using final-holdout outcomes.

earlier_memory_overlap.baseline: Frozen Forecast already contains current and immediately-prior raw fantasy points, their difference, and prior-coverage.
earlier_memory_overlap.phase2_q3: Earlier diagnostic tested the incremental coefficient on one immediately-prior age/state-adjusted residual after controlling for current residual; it did not test a prior-only two-season level/stability summary.
earlier_memory_overlap.phase34_C: C used one prior age/state residual plus coverage only in prime/aging QB and aging WR/TE probability models, with separate memory diagnostics. Fixed routing retained C only for QB.
earlier_memory_overlap.stage3_M3a: M3a tested directional current-minus-prior residual change and a two-year slope. It did not test prior-only track-record level/stability.

family_A_multi_year_consistency.distinctness: A prior-only two-season consistency summary can be isolated from current magnitude, current-to-prior trajectory, raw prior production, A2 age, D current within-state location, and QB C one-lag memory.

proposed_experiment_not_executed.scope: conditional-production adjustment only; persistence/state probabilities frozen
features: prior2_mean_age_state_z = mean(z[t-1], z[t-2]) when both genuine prior seasons exist
prior2_abs_gap_age_state_z = abs(z[t-1] - z[t-2]) when both genuine prior seasons exist
prior2_coverage flag; uncovered continuous values set to neutral zero with explicit missingness
exclusions: no current residual in the consistency feature family
no repeated-elite thresholds or extra hard tiers
proposed_experiment_not_executed.pooling: regularized global effects with position deviations only; no smaller position x age x trajectory cells. All four position cells have at least 79 complete prior-two rows in each official horizon validation block.
proposed_experiment_not_executed.validation: same Stage 3 chronological validation blocks and clustered uncertainty; freeze construction before any validation is viewed
proposed_experiment_not_executed.holdout: remain pristine unless a later management directive explicitly authorizes this experiment and subsequent final evaluation

family_A_multi_year_consistency.why_prior3_not_primary: Three-prior-season coverage falls to roughly 38%-46% by position in validation, with Y3 QB support only 62 rows. It is inventoried but not recommended as a separate primary feature family.
